o.text: Inherited from Proto-Common Turkic *apa (“mother, elder sister, aunt”).
Morphologically on dörd + -üncü. Cognate with Turkish on dördüncü.
mənsub + -iyyət. Perhaps, calque of Russian принадлежность (prinadležnostʹ).
From yarım + müdafiəçi. Calque of Russian полузащи́тник (poluzaščítnik).
